target_customer: Brand, social and consumer insights teams at large consumer brands and their agencies
problem: Text based social listening misses what is said and shown in short form video on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. Syncly analyzes speech, on screen text and visible products.

founders.name: Joseph Lee
previous_startups: Sualab (video AI, $200M exit per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says the co-founders are former founders of Sualab, without assigning roles.

technical_complexity.rationale: Understanding video with speech, on screen text and product recognition across several platforms needs multimodal models and heavy data collection, built by founders who had previously sold a computer vision company.

defensibility.rationale: Incumbent listening tools could add video models, and platform data access is rented. Video understanding quality and customer workflows give some edge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established from a dated source. A Sprout page says Hootsuite acquired Talkwalker in April 2024 and later comparisons credit Talkwalker with video AI.

market_need_then: Short form video was taking attention from text feeds by 2022 and 2023, and brands relied on agencies for insights. No dated demand source was opened beyond the company's own claims.

identity.logo: Not described by any source seen
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and outcome focused, framed as going beyond the caption

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: Social listening for the video era

brand_strength.rationale: A clear tagline, but the name is near identical to Cyncly, a larger software company that rebranded to that name in 2022, and a Syncly trademark application for the Class 42 name is pending. No press on the brand itself.

pivots.from: Customer feedback analysis for CX teams (per the title of the seed announcement)
pivots.to: Social listening for video and agentic video marketing for consumer brands
pivots.why: Not stated in sources seen. The seed post title mentions CX teams while the current site and YC page describe social listening.

outcome_analysis: Syncly is run by repeat founders from Sualab and raised a 3.3 million seed backed by SoftBank Ventures Asia, YC and others after Winter 2023. The YC page claims 2.1 million in ARR and 142 percent net dollar retention, which are self reported. It has moved from CX feedback to video social listening and is still active, so the outcome is open.
notes: Seed date conflicts: some sources say November 2023, CB Insights lists a 2.64M seed on 2023-05-09 and Seedtable 2.8M in May 2023, so the date is recorded as 2023 only. Total raised is unclear. ARR and NDR claims come from the YC page. Sualab sale price of about 200M to Cognex in 2019 comes from a search summary and the YC page. Team size 9 on the YC jobs page versus 15 on the company page. No dated 2023 competitor source was opened, so that list is empty.
